items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk highlights Grok’s ability to analyze any uploaded video
items_flat.title_zh: Elon Musk 強調 Grok 可分析任何上傳影片
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that “Grok can analyze any video,” sharing a demonstration link. Grok itself confirmed it samples frames, runs vision analysis for scenes/objects/motion/artifacts, transcribes audio, and fuses temporal reasoning with real-world knowledge; multi-hour VODs are sampled for efficiency.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 發文表示「Grok 可分析任何影片」，並分享示範連結。Grok 本身確認會採樣幀、進行場景／物體／動作／偽影視覺分析、轉錄音訊，並結合時間推理與現實知識；多小時 VOD 會採樣以提高效率。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an executive product-capability signal rather than a formal model or API launch. It reinforces Grok’s multimodal vision stack already shipping, but leaves open questions on density limits for long videos and production reliability.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是執行長層級的產品能力訊號，而非正式模型或 API 發表。它強化了 Grok 已上線的多模態視覺堆疊，但長影片的採樣密度上限與實際穩定度仍待觀察。
